{
  "phoneNote": "The prominent clinic photo and readable headline work well, but the location is buried near the footer and widely separated hero links make the opening unnecessarily tall.",
  "desktopNote": "The clinic photography gives the page credibility, but oversized section padding and a half-empty team section weaken the overall rhythm.",

    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Bring the Maribor location into the hero beside the practice identity, so visitors understand where the clinic is before scrolling.",
    "Tighten desktop section padding and the mobile hero’s link spacing; stack the mobile team entries so the dentist’s credentials have a comfortable line length.",
    "Keep one prominent booking action in the hero and the final booking section, remove intermediate call-link repetition, and make the reassurance section add visual depth rather than repeat the opening."
  ],
